question:
Study the following table showing the production of four crops (in thousand tonnes) across five states, and answer the question.

State | Rice | Wheat | Maize | Pulses
Punjab | 120 | 180 | 40 | 10
Haryana | 90 | 110 | 30 | 20
Uttar Pradesh | 150 | 160 | 90 | 50
Bihar | 80 | 50 | 60 | 30
Madhya Pradesh | 70 | 90 | 80 | 90

Q. In Bihar, the production of Pulses is what percentage of the production of Wheat?
explanation: For Bihar, Pulses = 30 and Wheat = 50. Percentage = (30 / 50) × 100 = 60%. Option B is incorrect because 50% would mean 25.

राज्य | चावल | गेहूं | मक्का | दालें

उत्तर प्रदेश | 150 | 160 | 90 | 50
बिहार | 80 | 50 | 60 | 30
मध्य प्रदेश | 70 | 90 | 80 | 90

प्र. बिहार में दालों का उत्पादन, गेहूं के उत्पादन का कितना प्रतिशत है?
explanation_hi: बिहार के लिए, दालें = 30 और गेहूं = 50। प्रतिशत = (30 / 50) × 100 = 60%। विकल्प B गलत है क्योंकि 50% होने पर मान 25 होता।

question:

Year | Arts | Science | Commerce | Law

question:
Study the following pie-chart distribution table showing the percentage share of various heads in a family budget totaling ₹60,000, and answer the question.

Budget Head | Percentage Share (%)
Food | 35%
Rent | 20%
Education | 15%
Savings | 15%
Miscellaneous | 15%

Q. What is the central angle (in degrees) corresponding to the expenditure on Rent?
explanation: Central angle for any sector = (Percentage share / 100) × 360°. For Rent, percentage share is 20%. Central angle = (20 / 100) × 360° = 72°. Option A is incorrect as 54° corresponds to 15%.
question_hi:

प्र. किराए पर होने वाले खर्च के संगत केंद्रीय कोण (डिग्री में) कितना है?
explanation_hi: किसी भी सेक्टर के लिए केंद्रीय कोण = (प्रतिशत हिस्सा / 100) × 360°। किराए के लिए प्रतिशत हिस्सा 20% है। केंद्रीय कोण = (20 / 100) × 360° = 72°। विकल्प A गलत है क्योंकि 54°, 15% के संगत होता है।

question:
Study the table and answer the question.

Patients Treated in Five Hospital Departments over Three Years
Department | 2021 | 2022 | 2023
Cardiology | 1200 | 1500 | 1800
Pediatrics | 2000 | 2200 | 2400
Orthopedics | 1500 | 1600 | 1700
Neurology | 800 | 900 | 1000
Emergency | 3000 | 3300 | 3600

Q. Which department recorded the highest average number of patients treated per year across the three-year period?
explanation: To find the department with the highest average, we find the one with the highest sum over the three years. Emergency sum = 3000 + 3300 + 3600 = 9900 (Average = 3300). Pediatrics sum = 2000 + 2200 + 2400 = 6600 (Average = 2200). Cardiology sum = 1200 + 1500 + 1800 = 4500. Orthopedics sum = 1500 + 1600 + 1700 = 4800. Thus, Emergency has the highest average.

कार्डियोलॉजी | 1200 | 1500 | 1800
बाल चिकित्सा | 2000 | 2200 | 2400
ऑर्थोपेडिक्स | 1500 | 1600 | 1700
न्यूरोलॉजी | 800 | 900 | 1000
आपातकालीन | 3000 | 3300 | 3600

प्र. तीन वर्ष की अवधि में प्रति वर्ष इलाज किए जाने वाले मरीजों की उच्चतम औसत संख्या किस विभाग में दर्ज की गई?
explanation_hi: सबसे अधिक औसत निकालने के लिए हम तीनों वर्षों के योग को देखते हैं। आपातकालीन कुल = 3000 + 3300 + 3600 = 9900 (औसत = 3300) है, जो सभी विभागों में सबसे अधिक है। अतः विकल्प C सही है।

question:
Study the table and answer the question.

Electricity Generated from Five Sources over Four Years (in million units)
Source | 2020 | 2021 | 2022 | 2023
Thermal | 450 | 480 | 500 | 530
Hydro | 200 | 210 | 190 | 220
Nuclear | 120 | 130 | 140 | 150
Solar | 80 | 110 | 150 | 200
Wind | 100 | 110 | 120 | 130

Q. What is the average annual electricity generated from Hydro power across the given four years?
explanation: Hydro generation for the four years: 200, 210, 190, and 220. Total = 200 + 210 + 190 + 220 = 820 million units. Average = 820 / 4 = 205 million units. Options A, C, and D are incorrect arithmetic.
explanation_hi: हाइड्रो का कुल उत्पादन = 200 + 210 + 190 + 220 = 820 मिलियन यूनिट है। औसत = 820 / 4 = 205 मिलियन यूनिट है। अतः विकल्प B सही है।
